mechanism: Betamethasone increases renal potassium wasting and sodium retention, while torsemide as a loop diuretic also promotes potassium excretion and electrolyte depletion, creating additive hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia risk.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (K+, Mg2+) regularly; consider potassium-sparing diuretic or potassium supplementation; monitor for arrhythmias and muscle weakness.
